# S0383: FlawedGrace

<a id="s0383"></a>

Type: malware  
ATT&CK: [S0383](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0383)  
Platforms: Windows  

[FlawedGrace](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0383) is a fully featured remote access tool (RAT) written in C++ that was first observed in late 2017.
